blurb: Blue Rock Springs Golf Club offers two 18-hole championship golf courses, the East Course and the West Course, providing 36 holes of golf. The facility includes a 28-stall driving range with grass tees on weekends, banquet facilities, and PGA-certified instructors for golf lessons. The club serves Vallejo and the greater Bay Area with competitive rates and has received local and national recognition.
